lines.text: But it is weird. [announcer voice] Welcome one, welcome all — it's DVDASA with your host, Asa Akira, and special guests Bill Poon and Money Mark. Here we go, here we go. We're missing a few people. Where is everybody?
I don't think we told anyone we're starting. I don't think Critter knows we started. I mean, Val's always around — where'd you go? I don't think anyone told anyone that we're starting.

And we've just been sitting here. Val and Steve have been talking about Adelita Bar in Mexico. "What's that?" They've been talking about Adelita Bar in Mexico. "Who was?" Steve and Val. Oh yeah, and Steve — where'd Steve go?
